exam.exam_name: Indian Overseas Bank Specialist Officers & Senior Manager Recruitment
exam.conducting_body: Indian Overseas Bank (IOB), Central Office Chennai

source_evidence.captured_wording: Photograph must be recent passport style colour picture (20 KB - 50 KB, dimensions 200 x 230 pixels) against a light background.
source_evidence.document_title: Recruitment of Specialist Officers in Various Streams / Categories in IOB

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.
dimensions.permitted_pixel_range: 200 x 230 px; 20 KB to 50 KB JPG; IBPS portal standard

requirements.content_instructions: JPG, JPEG; 200 x 230 px; 20 KB to 50 KB JPG; IBPS portal standard; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; Plain light background; Clear frontal portrait
PDF; 100 KB to 500 KB PDF scan; A4 original document; Mandatory post-qualification officer experience in banking or financial services

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: Recruitment of Specialist Officers in Various Streams / Categories in IOB - Annexure - Scan Guidelines (https://www.iob.in/upload/Careers/IOB_SO_Advt_2024.pdf)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.evidence_reference: Recruitment of Specialist Officers in Various Streams / Categories in IOB - Annexure - Scan Guidelines (https://www.iob.in/upload/Careers/IOB_SO_Advt_2024.pdf)
image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: Pixel dimensions transcribed from the cited source.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
